name: Sitting on Examination Chair
prompt: Standing with his back to a reclining laboratory examination chair, he bends both knees and lowers his hips naturally onto the seat, with his palms reaching the two armrests. Once seated, he extends both legs forward onto the sloped leg support, heels supported and toes naturally up. He eases his back into the chair and holds still. Keep both ankles aligned with the shins. No foot crossing, snap turns, jumps or twisting.
